payload.core_mechanism_summary: Count length-2 paths by iterating all edges a->b then b->c; store count per (a,c); compute rhombi as combinations of k intermediate nodes.
payload.rationale: Exhaustive enumeration of all directed paths of length 2. No DFS/BFS recursion, but effectively a depth-2 graph search. Other complete_search subtypes (backtracking, bitmask, etc.) are not used. Family matches.
